description: bigville R40 / INTEGRATION (block 331000): the cognitive agent LOOP -- C1-C6 wired live on one agent. cg_metabolize: per tick energy drains + competence goes stale + load recovers (cost of living). cg_state: sustenance_level=energy/max; urges (C1) = weight*(1-level); arousal=max urge; focus=Yerkes-Dodson(arousal) (C2); pursues = the dominant drive. Then ONE costed/impactful action per tick (C6), chosen by pursues: cg_eat (sustenance + food -> consume a unit, restore energy) / cg_work (competence + resource + energy -> spend energy, produce output=min(yield*FOCUS,stock) into the store, raise competence) -- each lays a POSITIVE Event (-> C3 memory -> mood). If the needed action can't happen: cg_hunger_frustrated / cg_work_frustrated lay a NEGATIVE Event and add allostatic load (C4). cg_break: load>window -> broken; cg_recover: load falls back -> recovered. The loop closes: a resourced agent self-maintains (works when it can, eats when hungry); a starved one declines and breaks.

rules.name: cg_metabolize
rules.comment: Cost of living: per tick energy drains, competence goes stale, load recovers a little.

rules.name: cg_state
rules.comment: Derived cognitive state: sustenance from energy; urges (C1); arousal; focus (C2); pursued drive.

rules.name: cg_eat
rules.comment: Pursued sustenance + food available: consume one unit, restore energy (a positive memory).

rules.name: cg_hunger_frustrated
rules.comment: Pursued sustenance but NO food: a negative memory + allostatic load (chronic frustration).

rules.name: cg_work
rules.comment: Pursued competence + resource + energy: spend energy, produce output=min(yield*focus,stock), raise competence (positive memory). Deposit write LAST.

rules.name: cg_work_frustrated
rules.comment: Pursued competence but no resource or no energy: negative memory + load.

rules.name: cg_break
rules.comment: Allostatic load over the window -> breakdown (C4).

rules.name: cg_recover
rules.comment: Load falls back within the window -> recovered.
